title: Logistics partner delay causing widespread next-day delivery failures
situation: 51 customers are affected with 4 VIPs and SAR 7,990 at risk due to delayed shipments.

params.reply_en: Your delivery is delayed with our logistics partner. We are expediting your shipment and have added 20 SAR store credit to your account.
params.reply_ar: تأخر توصيل شحنتك عبر شريك الخدمات اللوجستية. نحن نعمل على تسريع وصولها وأضفنا رصيد بقيمة 20 ريالاً لحسابك.

actions.why: Provide immediate update and goodwill credit to affected customers.

actions.note: 51 delivery delays reported due to logistics partner issues.
